protocol_note: The terminal round was refuted under its own §3 protocol, on the DRAFT: every disposition below was applied to the file BEFORE its first commit, so the panel's verdict preceded the landing (the sequencing §7 records). Contested quotes were conductor-verified against the round sources via a dedicated read-only extraction agent (verbatim §8 declarations of R5b/R5/R4/R6 with line numbers) — where two seats contradicted each other, the source decided.

dispositions.claim: §3.3 forbids proxies setting production state, yet §2.5 flips the production default off the back of an LLM-proxy panel — the doctrine's central rule is violated by its own register
dispositions.note: the rule was under-specified, not the flip wrong: §3.3 restated in two halves — a proxy may never PROMOTE a contested variant, and pending the gate production holds the LEAST-CLAIM arm (the variant asserting nothing unverified). The team control is the least-claim arm; the flip is an instance of the rule, not a proxy promotion. §2.5 gloss cross-references it (agy 2, qwen C1)
